# Discord Mappings

An attempt at creating mappings for the `discord_web` client, and possibily others too!
I'm trying to make mappings for each chunk and its name, module path, variables names, etc.

This project does not provide the decompiled results, to prevent a dmca. instead you have to download discord chunks files into a folder named `chunks`, and run `map.js`.

## Paths

The paths are the official one, taken from the react native app.

### Autogenerated

Please avoid wasting your time on adding these, they are auto generated.

-   Stores have auto generated finders, there is false positives, but it doesn't matter as the script has to find the exact `static displayName = '...'` thing
-   Assets are auto generated, by using the list of assets in android, ios etc
-   Experiments are auto generated, so please dont waste your time on them.

## Contributing

If you want to help grow this project, you can add more mappings to `mappings/paths.txt`, or more autogenerated paths to `scripts/`.

### Notes:

-   please make sure all your `find_with` patterns don't produce duplicates.
-   please make sure the path is correct, and you didn't confuse a chunk being the path.
-   you can use regex but please try to avoid it if possible
-   please use `\w` in regex to match mangled identifiers, it'll be later replaced with the correct pattern for mangled ids by the `main.js` script.

1. To start, first run:

```sh
# clone latest web client src
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Wumpus-Central/discrapper-canary
cd development
# to download src of left files (android app src)
bash download_left.sh
```

2. Make the mappings, example:

```json
[
    ...
    {
        "find_with": [".get",".USER_ME"],
        "paths": ["paths (only official ones from android app)"]
    }
]
```

3. to generate output, run:

````sh
# to just generate output without regenerating the autogenerated ones.
node src/main.js
# to generate output for all & regenerate the autogenerated ones
bash gen_mappings.sh
```

3. open a pr
4. thanks!
````
